Office memo № 5
Ottisk opens documents, shows their pages and lets you work with them
without extra windows. Every page is redrawn when the zoom level changes,
so small print stays sharp and readable.
When a file is damaged, the program tries to rebuild the object table and
reports it quietly. A signature proves that the document has not changed since
signing and who signed it.
A form can be filled in, saved and sent; the total field recalculates on its own.
Comments live inside the document: notes, highlights, underlines and
freehand drawings.
Text recognition turns a picture of a page into a document that search can
work with. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the river flows
past the old mill.
